set.game[description]:
Want the whole set? The PSX Character Library holds the CSAF PSX character packs on one page, plus every new one, for $19.99.

Bloom is 14 low poly PS1-style infected crew of a deep space station, the enemies for a science fiction survival horror game, for Godot 4, Unity and Unreal, rigged and animated, with a free sampler on this page. Every character has 45 animation clips on one humanoid skeleton, 3 palette skins (42 to place), 1,496 to 1,500 triangles and one 256 px texture per skin, in GLB, FBX, OBJ and Blender formats. Use them in any number of commercial games, no attribution required.

What you get

  • 14 infected from one station: a rigger and an ore miner in orange jumpsuits, an EVA technician in a cracked pressure undersuit, a lab technician, a security officer in an armoured vest, the galley cook, the captain in a burgundy command jacket, the medic, a shuttle pilot, the comms officer, a reactor technician, the company executive in a charcoal suit, the hydroponics technician where it started, and the first host, gaunt and overgrown. Every one an adult, each a different body and painted outfit.
  • One contagion: grey ashen skin, milky eyes, dark veins and the same crusted pale fungal growth bursting through torn station clothing on every character, with dark dried stains and no open gore, so a level reads as one outbreak.
  • The other half of Deep Station: our Deep Station pack is the living crew; Bloom is what hunts them, on the same skeleton and clip names, and both stand in the PSX space station kits already on the shelf.
  • 3 palette skins each: the main garment changes colour; faces, skin, the growth, hair and boots keep their paint, so one character can fill a corridor.
  • 45 animation clips plus a T-pose: idle, walk, formal walk, jog, sprint, crouch, jump, roll, punches, pistol aim, shoot and reload, sword, spell, two hit reactions, a death, sit, sit and talk, swim, push, pick up, interact, kneel and fix, talking, torch idle, dance and driving.
  • PSX ready: textures quantised to 15-bit colour for nearest filtering, and a PSX shader for Godot 4 (vertex snapping, affine texture warp, dithering, distance fog).
  • Per character: a GLB with every clip, a GLB per extra skin, FBX with the skeleton and clips, OBJ + MTL, PNG textures and the Blender source.

Limits: the hands are simple mittens and nothing is held, and the growth is painted on the texture, not modelled, so the silhouettes stay human. The bodies are close fitting, so there are no long coats: every jacket ends at the hip. The 45 clips are the standard humanoid set (walk, sprint, punches, crouch, hits, death); there is no dedicated zombie shamble clip.

In your project

Godot 4: copy models/ and shaders/ into the project and instance a _skin0.glb. Tested in a blank Godot 4.7.2 project: every GLB imports, the shader compiles and the clips play.

Unity 6 and Unreal 5: import the FBX and set the textures to point filtering; the skeleton retargets with Unity Humanoid or an Unreal IK Rig. These two engines were not run here; the FBX files were re-imported in Blender to check the mesh, 53 bones and every clip. The full Readme has the import notes and the clip list.

Try it free

The free sampler on this page is the first host: all three skins, every clip, every format and the shader. The PSX Characters Sampler is a separate free download with one character from each of our other PSX packs.

Pairs with: Deep Station (14 PSX space horror crew, the survivors) and Outpost (PSX sci-fi colony marines), all on the same skeleton.

Licence and how it was made

Use the models in any number of commercial or free games, no attribution and no royalty, and modify them freely. Do not resell or redistribute the models, textures or animations themselves as assets. The skeleton and clips are the CC0 Quaternius Universal Animation Library; the bodies are generated with MakeHuman (CC0 output).

Made with AI tools: the bodies were built by scripts an AI system wrote, and every texture is an AI image model's painting projected onto the mesh. Code: yes. Graphics: yes. Sounds: no. Text: no.

Rate it or leave a comment if it works in your game. Made by Core Systems Asset Factory.
